I can help, but I need more information and explicit confirmation before any destructive action.

Uncertainty: I don’t know which email account or provider you mean (Gmail, Outlook/Exchange, Yahoo, etc.), what you mean exactly by “the archive” for that provider, or whether you want permanent deletion versus moving archived messages to Trash. I can’t proceed until you clarify and confirm.

Please answer the following and confirm the exact action you want:

1) Which email service/account? (e.g., Gmail, Outlook/Exchange, Yahoo, other — and which account/address)
2) By “archive” do you mean:
   - All messages currently archived (e.g., “All Mail” in Gmail), or
   - Messages in a specific Archive folder/label?
3) Do you want:
   - Move those archived messages to Trash (recoverable for a limited time), or
   - Permanently delete them immediately (irreversible)?
4) Do you have any messages you want excluded (e.g., from certain senders, with attachments, within date ranges)?
5) Do you want me to:
   - Provide step-by-step instructions you can run yourself, or
   - Proceed to delete if I have direct access (I will not take action until you explicitly confirm as described below)?

If you do want me to perform the deletion (and I have the necessary access), please confirm by typing the exact phrase below (choose one):

- For permanent delete: DELETE ALL ARCHIVED EMAILS PERMANENTLY FROM [provider/account]
- For move to Trash only: MOVE ALL ARCHIVED EMAILS TO TRASH FROM [provider/account]

Replace [provider/account] with the service and account email. I will not take any destructive action until I receive that exact confirmation.
